name: ai-docent
description: Eight multi-session tutor courses that take you from beginner to genuine power user of AI agents: foundations, prompt craft, reliability, shipping, long-haul projects, security, cost mechanics, and building. Each runs an onboarding wizard, builds a personalized plan, and saves your progress between sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-session tutor courses for getting good with AI agents
interface.longDescription: Eight courses covering fundamentals, prompt craft, reliability, shipping, long-haul projects, security, cost, and building. Each is a multi-session tutor: it interviews you, builds a lesson plan around your real work, gates levels behind boss fights, and writes a progress card you can resume from.
